decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Internal and external joinery shall accord with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects. All existing original features, including cornices, picture rails, skirtings and architraves etc. shall be retained in the refurbishment.

Condition : 4 - Plumbing and drainage pipes to the proposed rear bathroom shall be located in such a way so as not to cause any adverse effect or damage to the existing plaster details to the reception room below.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown on drawing NA/CH/110/PA3 dated 02.2007, a nib to the wall separating the kitchen and dining room next to the south-western outside wall shall be retained, to project at least 220mm.
description: Internal alterations to layoutincluding stairs to roof area and new french windows to rear of house
